name: The BIG Guns! raises party attack power and the Tinker's ranged attack power (#1271)
contract: #1271: The BIG Guns! 560593 needs no script. Effects 0 and 1 are SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65) with SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER_PCT (166) and SPELL_AURA_MOD_RANGED_ATTACK_POWER_PCT (167), both BasePoints 4 DieSides 1 (+5%) and EffectRadiusIndex 287 (SpellRadius.dbc row 287 = 100 yd); effect 2 is a plain APPLY_AURA on the caster with aura 167, BasePoints 2 DieSides 1 (+3%). AuraEffect::HandleAuraModAttackPowerPercent and HandleAuraModRangedAttackPowerPercent call SetStatPctModifier with GetTotalAuraMultiplier, so the caster's ranged multiplier is 1.05 * 1.03 = 1.0815 while everyone else in the group gets 1.05. The ranged handler's CLASSMASK_WAND_USERS early return covers priest, mage and warlock only, so Tinker (class 28) is unaffected by it. AttributesEx3 carries SPELL_ATTR3_ONLY_ON_PLAYER (0x100), so the group members must be players. Unit::GetTotalAttackPowerValue multiplies the attack-power fields by UNIT_FIELD_ATTACK_POWER_MULTIPLIER, which is what these ratios read. The exclusive-same-effect rule with Trueshot Aura (spell group 2000180) is generic spell_group_stack_rules data and needs a second, non-Tinker buff source; it is deliberately not asserted here.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Put both Tinkers in one party
Baseline attack power of the caster
Baseline attack power of the party member
Baseline ranged attack power of the caster
Baseline ranged attack power of the party member
The area aura reaches the party member
The caster's attack power rises by 5%
The party member's attack power rises by 5%
The party member's ranged attack power rises by 5%
The caster's ranged attack power rises by 1.05 * 1.03
